limitations: No excluded project material was opened or received. Project reads were restricted to the assigned allowlist.

Open count includes failed opens/clicks and treats each requested URL and its redirect chain as one target. Each of the 35 requested URL targets was opened once. Find requests searched already-returned references; some returned fetch errors or no matches.
Official search excerpts are explicitly marked when a full page failed. No unsupported facts were supplied from memory, venue fame, producer labels, ranking or omissions.
Several secondary themes remain unknown because the inspected official extracts do not establish them. Unknown is not a negative relevance judgment.
Nineteen exact venue targets received no individually inspected official description under the capped URL allocation. Their three dimensions are unknown with explicit budget exclusions.

Some opened pages supplied no usable thematic detail: La Pedrera homepage, Poble Espanyol homepage, BrightSide homepage, BIG FUN full page, the Dama del paraguas full page, Picasso homepage, La Virreina city page, Montjuïc Castle city page and the dedicated Xocolata tourism page. Relevant alternative official material is cited where available.
Casa Padellàs was not explicitly identified by the inspected Plaça del Rei material; nearby archaeological relevance was not transferred to the supplied canonical identity.

Review concerns venue or operator offerings, not opening feasibility, booking, itinerary inclusion, pace, price or actual visits. Operator relevance concerns advertised services rather than office visits.

Art includes explicitly documented visual art and performing arts; geographic location alone does not establish historic-neighbourhood relevance. Distinct architectural evidence is required beyond merely occupying a building.
No not_relevant verdicts were asserted: the inspected evidence supported positive themes or left precise gaps, rather than establishing thematic exclusion.
